label: preparing
what: A coordinated supper in the great hall, possibly with an undisclosed celebratory purpose. The innkeeper originally asked the secretary to escort me while describing it only as routine business. I now know and approved the public civic supper, but that initial concealment suggests a possible surprise beyond it; an anniversary celebration is plausible, not established. Innkeeper organizes provisions and lighting, baker has reserved thirty-nine loaves, freight arranges grain and delivery, and secretary knowingly assists booking and escort, though knowledge of any hidden purpose is unproven.
